messages:
Priya Rao: Kicking off bring-up for kestrel-embed-v1 int8 on staging. Quick smoke + recall/cluster checks. baseline = raven-embed-v2 fp16.
Diego Chen: running the standard holdout (semantic-holdout-10k) now, will post numbers in a sec.
Diego Chen: ```
Dataset: semantic-holdout-10k
k=1: 0.744 (baseline 0.761)
k=5: 0.914 (baseline 0.922)
mean_cosine_shift: -0.012
notes: per-tensor asymmetric int8 quant via onnxruntime dynamic
```
Aisha Patel: ugh r@1 down ~1.7% absolute. r@5 smaller drop but noise. Any difference in pooling/norming between models?
Priya Rao: same pooling code path, L2 normalize at inference. Quant used per-tensor to keep pipeline simple for now.
Tom Nguyen: can we try per-channel quantization? last time it helped with small r@1 regressions on low-dim heads.
Diego Chen: good call. spinning a per-channel int8 run (weights per-channel, activations per-tensor) — ETA ~10m.
Aisha Patel: also check clustering visuals with UMAP; fragmentation sometimes hints at centroid shifts rather than global scale change.
Priya Rao: attached two quick UMAP snapshots from staging run — note cluster for "billing/payment" looks split into two lobes; centroid moved ~0.06 cosine from baseline.
Tom Nguyen: if centroid drift is consistent, a small calibration/rescaling might recover r@1 without re-training.
Diego Chen: per-channel run finished. numbers:
```
k=1: 0.757 (baseline 0.761)
k=5: 0.920 (baseline 0.922)
mean_cosine_shift: -0.003
```
Diego Chen: per-channel cut the gap a lot. still slightly below baseline at r@1 but within noise.
Aisha Patel: that suggests weight quantization granularity was the main factor. Any latency/cost delta?
Priya Rao: per-channel inference perf ~+2% token latency on our mini-bench, memory similar. CPU quant path unchanged.
Tom Nguyen: that's acceptable for Dedicated customers; for hosted we might prefer per-tensor for cost-sensitive tiers. Could provide two variants.
Priya Rao: action items: (1) run KNN stability with different seeds and short queries (2) rerun on long-context samples (3) add a quick eval that compares classification recall by intent label.
Diego Chen: starting seed sweep now (5 seeds) and short-query subset.
EvalBot: Automated check: r@1 regression = 0.006 vs baseline, threshold 0.01 -> PASS. Added regression summary to ML dashboard.
Aisha Patel: let's also gate canary rollout: per-channel as default for kestrel-v1-int8, with a fallback to fp16 raven if customer requests higher precision.
Priya Rao: agreed. I'll open PR for model-catalog entries and add a canary policy (5% traffic, 24h metrics watch).
Tom Nguyen: ping me for the PR review. Also add a note in the release doc about cluster drift observed and mitigation (per-channel quant + calibration).
Priya Rao: thanks all — will post the PR link and final numbers once the seed sweep finishes. :thumbsup:
